items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Well, anything with Charlie Shavers and Buster Bailey and Russell Procope on that particular album, they were originals, because they were written especially when we had the show, Flow Gently Sweet Rhythm.

ctx.x: "St. Louis Blues" again and "The Hour of Parting."

I don't have those either. But it'll be interesting to note that Roy Eldridge played along with the Kirby Orchestra on this too. I don't know how Roy happened to wonder into the studio. But he was on "Hour of Parting" and "St. Louis Blues" too. It says Charlie Shavers was there, but it was actually Roy Eldridge.
